faq: Can you use my existing spreadsheet data?
Yes. We import it on day one, tidy obvious errors such as duplicates and mixed date formats, and show you a summary of anything we could not match. Your original sheet stays untouched.
Does it need to be online?
It runs in the browser, so staff need an internet connection. For tools used in places with weak signal, ask about the progressive web app service, which adds offline use.
Small changes, such as a new field or status, are easy and we show you how to make some yourself. Larger changes can be a new order. We build in clear parts to keep changes cheap.
Is it safe to put staff data in?
We use secure sign-in, encrypted connections and limited roles, and we host it in your own cloud account. For very sensitive data, tell us in the form and we plan extra protection.

desc:
Internal tools to replace spreadsheets give your team proper forms, tables, search and approvals in place of copy-paste and shared files. Ecom Swift LLC builds a simple tool around your real process and imports your existing sheet data so nothing is retyped.

## What is an internal tool?

An internal tool is a web app built for your own staff rather than for customers. It handles tasks such as tracking jobs, managing inventory, logging requests, approving expenses or reviewing applications. Staff sign in with their own accounts and see the screens and records that suit their role.

Most start life as a spreadsheet. When the sheet gets long, shared by many people or tied to rules only one person remembers, it is a sign that a purpose-built tool would help.

## Why spreadsheets stop working

Spreadsheets are flexible, which is why teams love them and why they break. Anyone can overwrite a formula, two people edit different copies, and an important column gets deleted without notice. There is no clean history of who changed what, and no safe way to give a new hire access to only part of the data.

Manual steps hide in the gaps: a message asking for approval, a note to update another tab, a reminder in someone's head. Each of these is a place where work can stall or go wrong.

## How an internal tool affects your results

The gain here is time, accuracy and control rather than sales. Forms with required fields stop incomplete entries. Search and filters find a record in seconds instead of minutes of scrolling. Approval steps route work to the right person with a record of the decision, so fewer things wait on a forgotten email.

Over a month, small savings across several people add up to real hours, and fewer mistakes mean less rework. How much you save depends on how often the process runs and how painful it is today, so we usually begin with the single biggest pain point.

## What a great internal tool includes

- A form for each type of entry, with the right fields and rules about what is required.
- Tables with search, sorting and filters that match how staff look for records.
- Staff login using individual accounts, never a shared password.
- Roles so staff, managers and admins see only what they need.
- Your existing sheet data imported on day one, with duplicates and gaps flagged.
- An activity history on each record showing who changed what and when.
- Email alerts when something needs attention.
- Approval steps with comments for processes that need sign-off.
- Exports to CSV for the occasions when a sheet is still needed.
- A dashboard of key numbers for managers.

## What we do

We watch how the work is done today, including the shortcuts, and agree which process to replace first. Then we design the screens, import your data, build the rules and test with the people who will use it. We adjust wording and layout until it feels natural to them.

The Basic package replaces one spreadsheet process with a simple tool, search, staff login and imported data. Standard adds linked processes, staff and manager roles, email alerts, CSV export and a history on each record. Premium adds more linked processes, approval steps with comments, a dashboard, connections to two tools you use and a staff training call. Add-ons include an extra process, a dashboard page and a training video.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Pick the process that causes the most wasted time first.
- Let the people who do the work show us how it really runs.
- Clean obvious errors in your sheet before the import.
- Decide who can see and edit each kind of record.
- Plan a short trial period before retiring the old sheet.

**Avoid:**
- Rebuilding every spreadsheet at once.
- Copying a messy sheet layout exactly into the tool.
- Sharing one login among the whole team.
- Removing the old sheet before staff trust the new tool.
- Adding rarely used fields that slow down data entry.

## Who it is for

This service suits an operations manager who runs a team on a tangled workbook, a small business that tracks jobs, stock or leads in shared files, and a company where approvals happen in email threads. It also suits teams whose current tool charges per user for features they never open.

## What we need from you

Send the spreadsheet or sample data, a short description of each step in the process and the names of the roles involved. We never ask for passwords. Connections to other tools use access you grant as a collaborator, staff or developer user.
